title: CVS Refill Daily Event Volume
dataSources: GoodRx prices (`goodrx:price`), CVS refills (`cvs:refill`), pharmacy pickups (`pharmacy:pickup`), and prescription adherence logs (`prescription:adherence`).
app: GoodRx price lookups, CVS refill confirmations, pharmacy pickup logs, and prescription adherence trackers streamed into Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=cvs:refill
| bin _time span=1d
| stats count as events, dc(drug_name) as distinct_entities by _time
| sort - _time
description: Counts how many CVS refill events land each day and how many distinct drug values are represented.
value: Daily volume is the fastest way to spot a dead feed, a sudden burst, or a workflow that quietly changed.
implementation: Ingest CVS refill records into `index=personal`; schedule daily and compare count and distinct drug values against your normal baseline.
visualization: Column chart of daily event count with a line for distinct entities.
grandmaExplanation: It checks how much CVS refill activity showed up each day so you can see if the feed went quiet or suddenly got busy.
